Run this document first, then render `results_text.Rmd` and `data_analysis.Rmd`.
It writes the shared clean dataset and cleaning summary beside these documents.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(countrycode)
```

# Import survey responses

```{r import}
data <- read.csv("../survey_11_21.csv", check.names = FALSE)
data_in_progress  = read.csv("../survey_11_21_in_progress.csv", check.names = FALSE)

data = bind_rows(data, data_in_progress)

data = data |> 
  select(-c(StartDate:Status), -c(RecordedDate:'Last Seen Question IDs'))

data = data[3:nrow(data), ]

```

# Participant exclusions

```{r participant-exclusions}
data_n = nrow(data)

data_filter_consent = data |>
  filter(consent == "Yes")

data_filter_consent_n = data_n - nrow(data_filter_consent)

data_filter_quality = data_filter_consent |>
  filter(data_quality != "No")

data_filter_quality_n = nrow(data_filter_consent) - nrow(data_filter_quality)

data_filter_duration = data_filter_quality |>
  filter(as.numeric(`Duration (in seconds)`) >= 60)

data_filter_duration_n = nrow(data_filter_quality) - nrow(data_filter_duration)

data_filter_non_academic = data_filter_duration |>
  filter(stage != "Currently not conducting research within an academic setting")

data_filter_non_academic_n = nrow(data_filter_duration) - nrow(data_filter_non_academic)

data_filter_no_ai 

data_filtered = data_filter_non_academic

data_filtered = data_filtered |> mutate(respondent = row_number())
data_filtered_n = nrow(data_filtered)
data_excluded_n = data_n - data_filtered_n
filter_counts = data.frame(
  Step = c("Survey responses", "Consent", "Data quality", "Duration (at least 60 seconds)", "Non-academic"),
  Excluded = c(0, data_filter_consent_n, data_filter_quality_n, data_filter_duration_n, data_filter_non_academic_n),
  Remaining = c(data_n, nrow(data_filter_consent), nrow(data_filter_quality), nrow(data_filter_duration), data_filtered_n)
)
knitr::kable(filter_counts)
```

# Prepare analysis variables

```{r prepare-variables}
data_filtered = data_filtered |>
  mutate(
    discipline_of_interest = case_when(
      discipline_1 == "Natural sciences" & discipline_2 == "Other natural sciences" ~ NA_character_,
      discipline_1 == "Natural sciences" ~ discipline_2,
      TRUE ~ discipline_1
    )
  )


data_filtered = data_filtered |>
  mutate(
    country_iso3 = countrycode(
      country,
      origin = "country.name",
      destination = "iso3c"
    ),
    continent = countrycode(
      country_iso3,
      origin = "iso3c",
      destination = "continent"
    )
  )


data_filtered = data_filtered |>
  rename(
    role_ra = ai_roles_1,
    role_ir = ai_roles_2,
    role_pr = ai_roles_3,
    role_je = ai_roles_4,
    role_gr = ai_roles_5,
    role_dm = ai_roles_6
  )

eu_uk_iso3 = c("AUT", "BEL", "BGR", "HRV", "CYP", "CZE", "DNK", "EST",
                "FIN", "FRA", "DEU", "GRC", "HUN", "IRL", "ITA", "LVA",
                "LTU", "LUX", "MLT", "NLD", "POL", "PRT", "ROU", "SVK",
                "SVN", "ESP", "SWE", "GBR")
data_filtered = data_filtered |>
  mutate(country_group = case_when(
    is.na(country_iso3) ~ NA_character_,
    country_iso3 == "USA" ~ "USA",
    country_iso3 %in% eu_uk_iso3 ~ "EU + UK",
    country_iso3 == "CHN" ~ "China",
    country_iso3 == "IND" ~ "India",
    TRUE ~ "Other countries"
  ))

data_filtered = data_filtered |>
  mutate(awareness_dichotomized = case_when(
    awareness %in% c("Not aware", "Heard about them, but know little") ~
      "Not familiar",
    awareness %in% c("Somewhat familiar", "Very familiar") ~
      "Familiar",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))

```

# Conflicting change selections

Invalidate the change answer when "do not intend to reconsider" is selected with
reconsidering research topics, reconsidering an academic career, or sacrificing
less of one's life to science. Also invalidate "prefer not to answer" together
with any other selection. Retain these participants for all other questions.

```{r clean-change}
change_respondents = data_filtered |>
  select(respondent, stage, change) |>
  filter(!is.na(change), nzchar(trimws(change)))

change_long = change_respondents |>
  select(respondent, change) |>
  separate_longer_delim(change, delim = ",") |>
  mutate(change = trimws(change)) |>
  filter(nzchar(change)) |>
  distinct(respondent, change)

# Remove conflicting selections from this question only.
change_invalid = change_long |>
  group_by(respondent) |>
  summarise(
    invalid = (
      "I do not intend to reconsider my research or career." %in% change &
      any(change %in% c("I am reconsidering research topics.",
                        "I am reconsidering my academic career.",
                        "I am considering sacrificing less of my life to science."))
    ) | ("I prefer not to answer." %in% change & n() > 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(invalid)

change_excluded_n = nrow(change_invalid)
data_clean = data_filtered |>
  mutate(change_invalid = respondent %in% change_invalid$respondent,
         change = replace(change, change_invalid, NA_character_))
```

# Remove open-ended responses for anonymity

```{r}
data_anonymous = data_clean |>
  select(-c(contains("TEXT"), comment, consensus))
```


# Save the clean dataset

```{r save-data}
write.csv(data_clean, "data_clean.csv", row.names = FALSE, na = "", fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
write.csv(filter_counts, "tables/cleaning_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
country_check = data_clean |>
  distinct(country, country_iso3, continent) |>
  arrange(country)
write.csv(country_check, "tables/country_check.csv")
write.csv(data_anonymous, "data/data_anonymous.csv", row.names = FALSE, na = "", fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
```
